title: Half-Day Quebec City Sea Kayaking Tour
includes: Equipment: sea kayak, paddle, spray skirt, mandatory safety equipment
Kayak clothing: wet suit, water shoe, waterproof jacket, glove
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Bring a swimsuit (for the wetsuit in May-June-October)
Please dress in athletic summer wear and bring water, lunch and snacks
Age restriction: must be at least 12 years old to participate
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
If canceled due to bad weather, you will be given the option of an alternative date or full refund
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the St. Lawrence River on a sea-kayaking tour for a memorable experience. With easy-to-follow techniques and sea-kayak equipment provided, this 3-hour tour is suitable for beginners and experts alike. You’ll learn about area history from your experienced guide and you'll capture great photos of the summer landscape. Bring your sense of adventure and come to try!
